cadd68dbf55da7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's Ramsar-site records?
o: Uttar Pradesh has the highest number of Ramsar sites, with 20
Uttar Pradesh ranks second with 13 Ramsar sites
Kolleru Lake is Andhra Pradesh's only Ramsar site, designated in 2002
Uttar Pradesh's tally rose from 11 to 13 with Shekha Jheel and Surha Tal
cadd68dbf55da7.x: Tamil Nadu, not Uttar Pradesh, has the highest number of Ramsar sites (20); Uttar Pradesh ranks second with 13.

ca23a0c7a2eea2.s: Which of the following Ramsar sites added in 2025 is wrongly matched with its State?
ca23a0c7a2eea2.x: Siliserh was one of Rajasthan's three 2025 additions (with Menar and Khichan); Bihar's were Gokul, Udaipur Jheel and Goga Beel.

ca0059e798ab77.s: As of June 2026, how many Ramsar sites did India have?
ca0059e798ab77.x: India had 100 Ramsar sites covering about 14 lakh hectares in June 2026, ranking first in Asia and third in the world.

ca80d4cef6ea74.s: Nagi Bird Sanctuary, a Ramsar site, is located in which State?
ca80d4cef6ea74.x: Nagi Bird Sanctuary is a Ramsar site of Bihar.

cacdcd3c881ebc.s: In which year was Longwood Shola Reserve Forest in Tamil Nadu designated a Ramsar site?
cacdcd3c881ebc.x: Longwood Shola Reserve Forest was designated in 2024, while Sakkarakottai and Therthangal Bird Sanctuaries followed in 2025.

cafc733087a3cd.s: Udhwa Lake, a Ramsar site, is located in:
cafc733087a3cd.x: Udhwa Lake is a Ramsar site of Jharkhand.

ca9477f13d0de6.s: Tsomoriri Lake in Ladakh was designated a Ramsar site in:
ca9477f13d0de6.x: Tsomoriri Lake (Ladakh) was designated in 2002; Surinsar–Mansar Lakes (Jammu & Kashmir) followed in 2006.

ca5feca29600ea.s: Loktak, Harike, Sambhar and Wular lakes were all included in India's Ramsar list in:
ca5feca29600ea.x: Loktak, Harike, Sambhar and Wular all belong to India's 1990 batch of Ramsar sites.

ca32d25d968844.s: Hygam and Shallbugh Wetland Conservation Reserves in Jammu and Kashmir were designated Ramsar sites in:
ca32d25d968844.x: Both Hygam and Shallbugh Wetland Conservation Reserves were designated in 2022; Hokersar Wetland was designated in 2006.

ca818c2db9bc68.s: Which of the following pairs of States/UTs each have five Ramsar sites?
ca818c2db9bc68.x: Gujarat and Jammu & Kashmir have five Ramsar sites each, while Karnataka has four and Himachal Pradesh three.

caa6dd5452dc0c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 'Women and Men in India 2025' report?
o: Rural women's LFPR rose from 37.5% to 45.9%
Women's growth in managerial positions was 102.54% against men's 73.80%
Women's GER in higher education rose from 37.5 to 45.9
Rural women showed the highest LFPR growth
caa6dd5452dc0c.x: Women's GER in higher education rose from 28.5 to 30.2; the 37.5% to 45.9% rise is rural women's LFPR.

caf765acc3cdbe.s: The Election Commission of India was established on:
caf765acc3cdbe.x: The Election Commission of India, a constitutional body headquartered in New Delhi, was established on 25 January 1950.

cabac6522be50f.s: Census 2027 is conducted under the Census Act of which year?
cabac6522be50f.x: The Census Act dates from 1948 and the Census Rules from 1990; the census authority is the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India.

ca95db2e57274a.s: The recording of every individual's caste in Census 2027 is legally based on:
o: The Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969
ca95db2e57274a.x: Caste enumeration in Census 2027 rests on Section 3 of the Census Act, 1948, not on the Census Rules, 1990.

cada0e5e273b92.s: What is the reference date of Census 2027 for most of India?
cada0e5e273b92.x: The reference date for most of India is 1 March 2027; Phase II in February 2027 covers population, socio-economic, education and caste details.

cad8e17e61e582.s: Under the new poll measures for the 2026 Assembly elections, a polling station can have a maximum of how many voters?
cad8e17e61e582.x: CEC Gyanesh Kumar's measures capped a polling station at 1,200 voters and put colour photographs of all candidates on EVMs.

cab9e7ff295ee9.s: The first complete census of India was conducted in:
cab9e7ff295ee9.x: The first complete census was held in 1881; the first census was in 1872.

cab31b4116f0b9.s: In the 2026 Assembly elections, Assam, Kerala and Puducherry went to the polls on:
cab31b4116f0b9.x: Assam, Kerala and Puducherry voted on 9 April 2026; counting was scheduled for 4 May.

ca9d96315c754e.s: Which Articles of the Constitution link Lok Sabha seats and delimitation with the census?
ca9d96315c754e.x: Articles 81 and 82 connect census-based information with Lok Sabha seats and delimitation.

cac7227c13b370.s: Which was the only State among the five States/UTs to poll in two phases in the 2026 Assembly elections?
cac7227c13b370.x: West Bengal alone polled in two phases, on 23 April and 29 April 2026.

cacab375463eef.s: India's sex ratio at birth during 2021–23 rose to:
cacab375463eef.x: The sex ratio at birth rose to 917 in 2021–23 from 904 in 2017–19.

nbf9c5b402e2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about IPL 2026?
o: Royal Challengers Bengaluru won the title
It was Royal Challengers Bengaluru's first IPL title
Royal Challengers Bengaluru won a second successive title
nbf9c5b402e2.x: Royal Challengers Bengaluru beat Gujarat Titans to win its second successive IPL title, so it was not its first.

ca90a7a5bfc641.s: Who was the Player of the Series at the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026?
ca90a7a5bfc641.x: Sanju Samson was the Player of the Series; Jasprit Bumrah was the Player of the Match in the final at Ahmedabad.

ca9d5241e69ee8.s: The ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 was which edition of the tournament?
ca9d5241e69ee8.x: The 2026 tournament, held from 7 February to 8 March 2026, was the 10th edition.

ca1ffed883b266.s: Which country qualified for the ICC Men's T20 World Cup for the first time in 2026?
ca1ffed883b266.x: Italy qualified for the T20 World Cup for the first time in 2026, under the 20-team format that began in 2024.

ca132480976e99.s: According to the World Press Freedom Index 2026, about how many countries declined in their press-freedom position?
ca132480976e99.x: The 2026 Index found about 100 countries declined, with press freedom at its lowest level in decades.

cadca89a181e0d.s: Which country ranked first in the World Press Freedom Index 2026?
cadca89a181e0d.x: Norway ranked first; Sweden was also in the top five, while Iran was in the bottom five.

ca0887215526d9.s: Reporters Without Borders, which publishes the World Press Freedom Index, is headquartered in:
ca0887215526d9.x: Reporters Without Borders was established in 1985 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

caaa454670e0a2.s: What was India's rank in the World Press Freedom Index 2026?
caaa454670e0a2.x: India fell 6 places, from 151st in 2025 to 157th in 2026.

cabf7ff8444ccd.s: Which of the following is one of the five indicators used in the World Press Freedom Index 2026?
cabf7ff8444ccd.x: The five indicators are political context, legal framework, economic context, socio-cultural context and safety of journalists.

n713ba170bc3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Bills passed by the Andhra Pradesh Assembly in 2026?
o: The AP Municipal Laws (Fourth Amendment) Bill restored direct election of Mayors
The AP Municipal Laws (Third Amendment) Bill provided a Uniform Mutation Fee
The AP Panchayat Raj (Second Amendment) Bill provided for two Vice-Presidents per MPP
Mayors were directly elected from 1986 until 2005
n713ba170bc3.x: The Panchayat Raj (Second Amendment) Bill went back to ONE Vice-President per MPP, not two.

n723300b002e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NTR Bharosa pensions in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Pensions reach the doorstep on the 1st of every month ('Pedala Sevalo')
Spouse pensions for surviving wives were introduced in 2026
Dialysis/CKDU patients get Rs 10,000 a month
Pensions for dialysis patients were abolished in 2026
n723300b002e.x: 2026 added pensions for dialysis and organ-transplant patients rather than abolishing them.

n3a8ea033d81.s:
Assertion (A): EAGLE of Andhra Pradesh signed an MoU with the Indian Red Cross Society on 28 August 2026 to check ganja and drugs at village level.
Reason (R): EAGLE is headquartered at Visakhapatnam.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3a8ea033d81.x: A is true: EAGLE (Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement) signed the MoU on 28 August 2026. R is false: EAGLE is headquartered at Vijayawada.

n97a9ed197ed.s: Which of the following pairs about Andhra Pradesh's Pedestrian Safety & Universal Accessibility Policy is correctly matched?
o: Basis – Supreme Court's S. Rajaseekaran ruling
AP's status – second State to notify such a policy
n97a9ed197ed.x: The policy is based on the S. Rajaseekaran ruling; AP is the first State to notify it (Cabinet, 6 Aug 2026), with a 2 m minimum walkway.

n709f54f9f67.s: Which of the following pairs about the 8th District Collectors' Conference of Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: Programmes reviewed – Super Six and Amaravati only
n709f54f9f67.x: The conference took up 19 subjects and reviewed Super Six, P4 and Swarna Andhra @2047; it was held at the Secretariat on 10-11 September 2026.

nc73ae602d35.s: What is the 2026-27 allocation for Mana Badi Mana Bhavishyathu (formerly Mana Badi Nadu-Nedu)?
nc73ae602d35.x: The 2026-27 allocation is ₹1,500 crore; ₹7,876 crore is the value of Nadu-Nedu works left incomplete.

n7f8c4f2cb92.s: Which Andhra Pradesh programme is the Adult Education Department's 100% literacy drive?
n7f8c4f2cb92.x: Akshara Andhra is the 100% literacy drive (literacy said to rise from 73% to 83%); Vidya Shakti is the IIT Madras STEM coaching tie-up.

n33328c4fb76.s: SHRESTH (State Health Regulatory Excellence Index) is run by:
n33328c4fb76.x: SHRESTH (Aug 2025) is run by CDSCO under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to benchmark State drug regulators.

n2f1027bbf3b.s: Who holds the Panchayat Raj & Rural Development portfolio in Andhra Pradesh?
n2f1027bbf3b.x: Deputy CM K. Pawan Kalyan holds Panchayat Raj & Rural Development (with Environment & Forests); Lokesh holds HRD and IT, Keshav Finance.

n9f525c0b187.s: In which year was e-Seva launched in Andhra Pradesh?
n9f525c0b187.x: e-Seva dates from 2001, while Meekosam came in 2015.

na8839ae659b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Andhra Pradesh Budgets presented on 14 February 2026?
o: The Agriculture Budget was K. Atchannaidu's first
Payyavula Keshav presented the main Budget 2026-27
K. Atchannaidu presented the Agriculture and Allied Sectors Budget
It was Payyavula Keshav's third Budget
na8839ae659b.x: It was Atchannaidu's third Agriculture Budget, not his first.

ncb1d52454ee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about agriculture in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Agriculture accounts for about half of the State's GSDP
Agriculture accounts for ₹5,39,454 crore of ₹17,62,357 crore (2025-26 AE)
AP produces about 10% of India's agricultural output
ncb1d52454ee.x: Agriculture's share is 33.20% of GSDP, about one-third, not half.

n0b2a3aa0f80.s: Which of the following pairs about Andhra Pradesh's Agriculture and Allied Sectors Budget 2026-27 is correctly matched?
o: Electricity subsidy for farm power – ₹14,277 crore
Highest allocation – Electricity subsidy for farm power
n0b2a3aa0f80.x: The Price Stabilisation Fund got ₹500 crore; irrigation got the highest allocation of ₹14,277 crore and farm-power subsidy ₹13,722 crore.

n64c921bbb66.s: As per the cited recent estimates, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n64c921bbb66.x: Andhra Pradesh recorded an MMR of 30 (India 88) and an IMR of 19 (India 25).

n2aeca8395a3.s:
Assertion (A): The Visakhapatnam-Chittoor-Kopparthy industrial corridor (VCIC) has nodes at Visakhapatnam, Chittoor and Kopparthy covering 33,000 acres.
Reason (R): The VCIC is financed by a World Bank loan of $625 million.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n2aeca8395a3.x: A is true. R is false: the $625 million loan (of $840 million) is from the Asian Development Bank, not the World Bank.

n39c756519a1.s:
Assertion (A): The pair 'Payyavula Keshav – Municipal Administration and Urban Development' is wrongly matched.
Reason (R): Municipal Administration and Urban Development is held by Ponguru Narayana, while Payyavula Keshav holds Finance.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n39c756519a1.x: Both are true, and R explains A: MA&UD is Ponguru Narayana's portfolio, Keshav holds Finance.

n7ca1b990bfc.s: Which of the following pairs about the International Fleet Review 2026 is correctly matched?
n7ca1b990bfc.x: The third International Fleet Review, at Visakhapatnam on 18 February 2026, had the theme 'United through Oceans'; 71 warships were reviewed from INS Sumedha.

n84f4da01d35.s:
Arrange the following Telugu Sahitya Akademi Award winners in chronological order of their award:
1. Tallapalli Patanjali Sastry
2. Boyi Bhimanna
3. Penugonda Lakshminarayana
n84f4da01d35.x: Boyi Bhimanna won in 1975 (Gudisale Kalipotunnayi), T. Patanjali Sastry in 2023 and Penugonda Lakshminarayana in 2024 (Deepika).

ne5a4815efd9.s: Udayagiri wooden cutlery, a GI-tagged product of Andhra Pradesh, is registered under which category?
ne5a4815efd9.x: Udayagiri wooden cutlery is a handicraft; Uppada Jamdani is handloom, Tirupati Laddu a foodstuff and Guntur Sannam chilli an agricultural product.

na933b420c8b.s: Justice (Retd.) T. Mallikarjuna Rao has been appointed Lokayukta of Andhra Pradesh for a term of:
na933b420c8b.x: Justice (Retd.) T. Mallikarjuna Rao's term as Lokayukta is five years.

n3cf626b1bc4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about judicial infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh?
o: It received ₹104.29 crore of central aid over five years
10 court complexes are complete and 24 under way
More than half of its 875 judicial posts are vacant
Court-complex progress is tracked on the Nyaya Vikas portal
n3cf626b1bc4.x: Only 137 of the 875 judicial posts are vacant, far less than half.

n8dc8405b772.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Bihar's mobile e-voting for urban local body polls (June 2025)?
o: The app 'e-Voting SECBHR' was developed by C-DAC
Voting was possible only through iOS applications
n8dc8405b772.x: The e-voting apps were Android apps, not iOS-only.

ne892817fde5.s:
Assertion (A): The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 on One Nation One Election proposes a new Article 82A.
Reason (R): The Bill amends Articles 330 and 332.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ne892817fde5.x: A is true: the Bill inserts Art. 82A and is with the JPC. R is false: it amends Arts. 83 and 172, not 330 and 332.

nfb8f32f8f60.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: AP Human Organ Transplantation Ordinance – June 2026
Supreme Court Number of Judges Ordinance – Article 213
AP Human Organ Transplantation Ordinance – Article 123
nfb8f32f8f60.x: The AP Human Organ Transplantation Ordinance was promulgated in June 2026; State ordinances like the Sri City University Ordinance use Art. 213, while the Supreme Court ordinance used Art. 123.

n50c7ce6c069.s: Which of the following pairs about small-savings schemes is correctly matched?
o: Funds credited to – National Small Savings Fund (Public Account)
n50c7ce6c069.x: Small-savings funds go to the NSSF in the Public Account; rates are set quarterly by the Finance Ministry and linked to G-Sec yields.

nce5faa619b9.s: India's current account deficit in 2025-26 was what percentage of GDP?
nce5faa619b9.x: India's CAD was 1.1% of GDP in 2025-26.

nb9c5b555524.s: The Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF) for Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities is run by:
nb9c5b555524.x: UIDF, announced in Budget 2023-24, is funded from the PSL shortfall and run by the National Housing Bank, not NABARD.

n69e594c59f2.s: How many initiatives does the RBI's Payments Vision 2028 (April 2026) contain?
n69e594c59f2.x: Payments Vision 2028 has 15 initiatives, including shared fraud liability of sender and receiver banks.

n110616d73ae.s: Andhra Pradesh's net GST collections in 2025-26 grew by:
n110616d73ae.x: AP's net GST grew 6% in 2025-26 despite a ₹4,500 crore hit from GST 2.0.

n3802a1a9531.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: The National Turmeric Board was set up in January 2025
The National Turmeric Board is headquartered at Nizamabad, Telangana
The Central Sector scheme for makhana has an outlay of ₹476.03 crore
The National Makhana Board is associated with Telangana
n3802a1a9531.x: The National Makhana Board is associated with Bihar; Telangana's Nizamabad hosts the Turmeric Board.

nef605551a70.s:
Assertion (A): The first Vande Bharat Express was started in 2019.
Reason (R): The first Vande Bharat Express ran between New Delhi and Katra.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nef605551a70.x: A is true. R is false: the first Vande Bharat Express (2019) ran New Delhi–Varanasi, not New Delhi–Katra.

n38103629568.s: Which of the following pairs about the Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan is correctly matched?
o: Nodal ministry – Ministry of Tribal Affairs
n38103629568.x: Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan is a Central Sector initiative of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs to train 20 lakh Adi Karmayogis across one lakh tribal villages.

n8545a9a5bea.s: The National Quantum Mission (2023-24 to 2030-31) is implemented by:
n8545a9a5bea.x: The National Quantum Mission is under DST, not MeitY, and envisages 50-1,000 qubit machines.

nfad9883bf44.s: Rashtriya Avishkar Abhiyan was launched in:
nfad9883bf44.x: Rashtriya Avishkar Abhiyan dates from 2015, between Make in India (2014) and Startup India (2016).

n2f69df3e4cf.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about committee and commission reports?
o: The All India Judicial Service has been accepted and implemented
The Kasturirangan Committee's recommendations led to NEP 2020
The Urjit Patel Committee's recommendations led to the 2016 RBI Act amendment
The 255th Law Commission report on totalisers is pending
n2f69df3e4cf.x: The All India Judicial Service is listed as pending, not implemented.

nf796dc2d973.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026?
o: It proposed amendments to Articles 81, 82 and 334A
It secured the required two-thirds majority
It sought early delimitation and women's quota
It was defeated in the Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026
nf796dc2d973.x: The Bill was defeated on 17 April 2026 because it lacked the required two-thirds majority.

na8e4bdf36f6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Law Commission reports on electoral reform?
o: The 255th Report recommended de-registering parties that skip elections for 5 years
The 170th Report recommended raising Lok Sabha strength by 25% through a party list
na8e4bdf36f6.x: The de-registration period in the 255th Report is 10 years, not 5.

ncadc3bbb51a.s:
Assertion (A): The National Tribunals Commission proposed in the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 will deal with appointments, reviews and discipline of tribunals.
Reason (R): The Commission will have five members, with headquarters in New Delhi.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncadc3bbb51a.x: Both are true, but its size and headquarters do not explain its functions. (The Bill was passed by the Lok Sabha in Aug 2026.)

nb5de10c5ff8.s: Which of the following pairs of report and publishing agency is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India – NCRB
nb5de10c5ff8.x: NCRB (MHA) publishes Crime in India, ADSI and Prison Statistics India; the SRS bulletin is brought out by the Registrar General of India.

n27cce139099.s: The National Testing Agency (NTA) is legally a:
o: Statutory body under an Act of Parliament
Department of the Ministry of Education
Society registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860
n27cce139099.x: The NTA is only a society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860; a petition after the 2026 NEET leak sought to make it statutory.

n88da5004d80.s: The Law Commission of India submits its reports to:
o: The Ministry of Law and Justice
n88da5004d80.x: The Law Commission, an executive advisory body set up by government order for three years, reports to the Ministry of Law and Justice.

n817caada6c7.s: According to Crime in India 2024, which State recorded the highest number of human-trafficking cases?
n817caada6c7.x: Telangana led in human-trafficking cases; Odisha had the highest violent-crime rate.

n1177fdcdfce.s: The National Commission for Higher Education and Research (NCHER) was proposed following the recommendations of the:
n1177fdcdfce.x: NCHER followed the Yashpal Committee (2009) and was announced by HRD Minister Kapil Sibal, but was never enacted.

n1aa17d82433.s: What was Andhra Pradesh's rank in the Fiscal Health Index?
n1aa17d82433.x: AP was 17th in the Fiscal Health Index; 5th was its rank in EPI 2024.

n1951279c753.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about upcoming Climate COPs?
o: COP31 will be the first COP held in the Amazon
COP31 will be held at Antalya under Türkiye's presidency
Australia presides over the negotiations at COP31
COP32 will be held at Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
n1951279c753.x: The first COP in the Amazon was COP30 at Belém (2025); COP31 (Nov 2026) is at Antalya.

nd87f9182af3.s:
Assertion (A): COP16 of the Convention on Biological Diversity set up the Cali Fund for benefit-sharing from digital sequence information.
Reason (R): The first CBD COP was held at Kunming in 1994.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd87f9182af3.x: A is true: COP16 (Cali, Oct 2024; resumed Rome, Feb 2025) created the Cali Fund. R is false: the first CBD COP was at Nassau, Bahamas, in 1994.

n6d6a8178737.s: Which of the following pairs about recent international summit developments is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: G20 Summit 2025 – skipped by the United States
COP30 – skipped by the United States
n6d6a8178737.x: COP30 pledges were voluntary; the US skipped both the 2025 G20 Summit and COP30, and the Quad Leaders' Summit stalled.

na4d98ca8acb.s: Which of the following pairs about BRICS expansion is correctly matched?
o: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and UAE – joined in 2025
na4d98ca8acb.x: South Africa joined in 2011; BRIC was coined in 2001, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and UAE joined in 2024 and Indonesia in January 2025.

n03241651ce6.s: Which of the following pairs about the Board of Peace launched at the WEF Davos meeting (January 2026) is correctly matched?
n03241651ce6.x: The US President launched the 27-member Board of Peace for Gaza reconstruction; India attends only as an observer without a vote.

n362fdbdd90a.s: Which SCO declaration condemned the Pahalgam and Jaffer Express attacks?
n362fdbdd90a.x: The Tianjin Declaration (2025) condemned both attacks; the Bishkek Declaration (2026), one of 28 documents adopted, approved an SCO-CSTO-CIS roadmap. (Sequence not buildable: only two dated items.)

n1720e4152ab.s: The G20 Johannesburg Leaders' Declaration (2025) included the first standalone ____ declaration since COVID.
n1720e4152ab.x: The Johannesburg Declaration included the first standalone debt declaration since COVID and set up a Cost of Capital Commission.

n7113f7eaaf0.s: MAHARISHI, an initiative launched under India's G20 Presidency, relates to:
n7113f7eaaf0.x: MAHARISHI is the millets research initiative; the G20 satellite is for climate monitoring and the Global Initiative on Digital Health also came under India's Presidency.

n67bb98e1b22.s: The 16th India-Japan Annual Summit (July 2026) was held in:
n67bb98e1b22.x: The summit was held in New Delhi, with PM Sanae Takaichi attending and a Joint Declaration on Economic Security covering five sectors adopted.

nd3cb80f3e6b.s: How many Quad leader-level summits were held during 2021–2024?
nd3cb80f3e6b.x: Six leader-level Quad summits were held in 2021–2024; none was held in 2025.

o: Present presidency and the next two presidencies
Past two presidencies and the present presidency
Present presidency, the IMF and the World Bank
n4a49b75e458.x: The Troika is the past, present and next presidencies; the G20 works through Finance and Sherpa tracks.

nefc7bd18eeb.s: What was the theme of the 18th G20 Summit hosted by India at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi?
o: Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet
One Earth, One Family, One Future
nefc7bd18eeb.x: India hosted the 18th G20 Summit on 9–10 September 2023 with the theme 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'.

nd79cda91e4a.s: The AI Impact Summit 2026, the first such summit in the Global South, was held at:
nd79cda91e4a.x: The summit was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 16–20 February 2026; its declaration was adopted by 92 countries and organisations.

n256af271e53.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UN Convention against Cybercrime?
o: It is the first global cybercrime treaty, adopted in December 2024
It was opened for signature at Hanoi in October 2025
It becomes binding 90 days after 40 ratifications
n256af271e53.x: The Convention's secretariat is UNODC, not UNCTAD.

n7cee3cc02da.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the U.S. exit from international bodies announced in January 2026?
o: It included the UNFCCC, IPCC and IRENA
The U.S. was described as the first country to attempt formal withdrawal from the UNFCCC
The International Solar Alliance was not among the bodies exited
UN Women and UNFPA were among the bodies exited
n7cee3cc02da.x: The ISA was among the bodies the U.S. exited, along with UNFPA, UN Women, UNHRC and UNCTAD.

n06f207e8bf4.s:
Assertion (A): Bangladesh became the first South Asian party to the Water Convention.
Reason (R): The Water Convention, adopted at Helsinki in 1992, concerns transboundary rivers and lakes.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n06f207e8bf4.x: Both are true, but the Convention's subject matter does not explain why Bangladesh was the first South Asian party.

n60b5980ec0f.s:
Assertion (A): The IMF's SDR basket consists of five currencies.
Reason (R): The Chinese yuan is not part of the SDR basket.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n60b5980ec0f.x: A is true: the basket comprises the US dollar, euro, Chinese yuan, Japanese yen and pound sterling. R is false because the yuan is included.

n7af1bd936bd.s: Which of the following pairs about the selection of the next UN Secretary-General is correctly matched?
n7af1bd936bd.x: Guterres leaves at the end of 2026 and the successor's five-year term begins on 1 January 2027; a candidate needs 9 'encourage' votes and no P5 veto.

n522a7ee4712.s: Which of the following pairs about BRICS and IMF voting is correctly matched?
o: BRICS share of IMF votes in 2011 – about 20%
BRICS current share of world GDP – about 20%
BRICS share of world GDP in 2011 – about 20%
BRICS current IMF vote share – roughly double the 2011 share
n522a7ee4712.x: In 2011 BRICS had about 20% of world GDP but only 11% of IMF votes; it now has about 40% of GDP with a vote share only barely higher.

nb14f7fccb7f.s: India's election to the UN Human Rights Council for 2026-28 is its:
nb14f7fccb7f.x: India was elected unopposed to the UNHRC for 2026-28, its 7th term.

n06e3e52c6a6.s: IMF lending is primarily intended to address:
n06e3e52c6a6.x: The IMF lends only to members, mainly for balance-of-payments problems; the Rapid Financing Instrument gives quick liquidity without a full programme.

nbf8f6c21981.s: Which trade agreement has been described as the 'Mother of All Deals'?
nbf8f6c21981.x: The India-EU FTA is called the 'Mother of All Deals'; the India-UK CETA is the 'Gold standard' deal.

n06fce80b86e.s: Which country was invited to join BRICS at Johannesburg in August 2023 but declined?
n06fce80b86e.x: Argentina declined; Egypt and Ethiopia joined on 1 January 2024 and Indonesia in January 2025.

n30ad2c93277.s: Under the WTO Agreement on Agriculture, Green Box measures are those that:
o: Are capped at a fixed share of production value
Relate exclusively to intellectual property rights
Are subject to annual reduction commitments
Have minimal or no trade-distorting effect
n30ad2c93277.x: Green Box support has minimal or no trade distortion and is not capped; IPRs fall under TRIPS.

n0d5d063fc69.s: Which country became the 10th member of the New Development Bank and its first from Central Asia?
n0d5d063fc69.x: Uzbekistan became the NDB's 10th member and the first from Central Asia; the NDB is headquartered in Shanghai.

nedb215c4298.s: Khalilur Rahman, elected President of the 81st UN General Assembly (2026-27), is from:
nedb215c4298.x: Khalilur Rahman of Bangladesh was elected in the Asia-Pacific Group's turn, defeating the candidate from Cyprus.

nd299c547a7f.x: India was certified polio-free in 2014; 2016 is Sri Lanka's malaria-free year.

ndb2f73bd7ef.s: India took over the chairmanship of the Kimberley Process on 1 January 2026 for the:
ndb2f73bd7ef.x: India, a founding member, took over the chair on 1 January 2026 for the third time; the Process has 60 participants (59 countries and the EU).

n1670a1a846a.s: The secretariat of the International Solar Alliance is located at:
n1670a1a846a.x: The ISA secretariat is at Gurugram; New Delhi hosts CDRI.

n6b650cca55e.s: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) is headquartered in:
n6b650cca55e.x: WMO, like WHO, ITU, WTO and ILO, is headquartered in Geneva.

n632610a9e1d.s: The WTO, created by the Uruguay Round, came into existence on:
n632610a9e1d.x: The Uruguay Round (eighth GATT round, begun 1986) led to the WTO on 1 January 1995.

nc5c31e0486e.s: The WHO Pandemic Agreement was adopted on:
nc5c31e0486e.x: The Agreement was adopted on 20 May 2025; talks on its PABS annex resumed in Geneva in July 2026.

ndab5e72c684.s: The Secretariat of APEC is located in:
ndab5e72c684.x: APEC has 21 economies and its Secretariat is in Singapore; India is only an observer.

n2d2d0d7f40c.s: The BBNJ (High Seas) Treaty entered into force on:
n2d2d0d7f40c.x: Adopted in March 2023, the BBNJ Treaty entered into force on 17 January 2026; India has signed but not ratified it.

ncc4c9f2d030.s: The UNFCCC Secretariat is located in:
ncc4c9f2d030.x: The UNFCCC secretariat is in Bonn, with 198 Parties.

ne1d81363d35.s: The Basel Convention was adopted in:
ne1d81363d35.x: The Basel Convention dates from 1989, after the Chicago Convention (1944) and before Stockholm (2001) and Minamata (2013).

ncace95eef89.s:
Assertion (A): The Defence Acquisition Council gave Acceptance of Necessity for 114 Rafale (MRFA) jets in February 2026.
Reason (R): India bought 36 Rafale jets for the IAF under a 2019 deal.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncace95eef89.x: A is true. R is false: the 36 IAF Rafales came under the 2016 deal, not 2019.

n1df4e491865.s: Which of the following pairs about India's foreign-policy approaches is correctly matched?
o: Neighbourhood First – energy and diaspora links with the Gulf
Link West – energy and diaspora links with the Gulf and West Asia
Neighbourhood First – origin at the 2019 swearing-in
Act East – energy and diaspora links with the Gulf
n1df4e491865.x: Gulf/West Asia energy and diaspora ties are the focus of Link West; Neighbourhood First began with SAARC leaders at the 2014 swearing-in.

nd59cd7a874a.s: The engine for India's AMCA Mk-2 is to be co-developed with:
nd59cd7a874a.x: The AMCA Mk-2 engine is to be co-developed with Safran, while the GE F414 is meant for AMCA Mk-1.

n218eaa53063.s: The India-China Strategic Economic Dialogue was set up in:
n218eaa53063.x: Set up in 2010, the Dialogue held six rounds in 2011-2019 and was suspended after Galwan in 2020.

n0e8e8c79c9d.s: The 2026 Quad Foreign Ministers' meeting in New Delhi launched a port project under the Ports of the Future Partnership in:
n0e8e8c79c9d.x: The meeting launched a Fiji port project and the Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration.

n9e5bf8c1b05.s: Yudh Abhyas is a joint military exercise between the armies of India and:
n9e5bf8c1b05.x: Yudh Abhyas is the India–US Army exercise held since 2004; its 22nd edition (Sept 2026) ran in Uttarakhand and Rajasthan.

n8193f0d7514.s: Exercise Veer Guardian is held between the Indian Air Force and the air force of:
n8193f0d7514.x: Veer Guardian involves the IAF and the Japan Air Self-Defence Force; its second edition was at Jodhpur in September 2026.

n5d335f826ab.s: Harimau Shakti is a joint army exercise between India and:
n5d335f826ab.x: Harimau Shakti is an India–Malaysia army exercise; Garuda Shakti and Samudra Shakti are with Indonesia.

n3db8408a4a7.s: The 13th edition of the multilateral naval exercise MILAN (February 2026) was held at:
n3db8408a4a7.x: MILAN 2026, the 13th edition, was at Visakhapatnam; MILAN began at Port Blair in 1995.

ncf93fcc6243.s: Which of the following was NOT associated with Visakhapatnam in February 2026?
ncf93fcc6243.x: MILAN 2026, IFR 2026 and the IONS Conclave were at Visakhapatnam in February 2026; DOSTI-16 was not part of this grouping.

nb02cd50fbde.s: JIMEX is a bilateral naval exercise between India and:
nb02cd50fbde.x: JIMEX is the India–Japan naval exercise, alongside Veer Guardian (air force) and Dharma Guardian (army).

n0321e556f43.s: The S-400 Triumf air-defence system, referred to as 'Sudarshan Chakra' in India, is of ____ origin.
n0321e556f43.x: The S-400 Triumf is a Russian-origin system with a stated range of 400 km.

n771ba35a6f2.s: Mission Sudarshan Chakra aims to build a multi-layer defence shield by:
n771ba35a6f2.x: The multi-layer shield is targeted by 2035, modelled on Israel's Iron Dome.

n4615455f47a.s: Exercise Khanjar is a Special Forces exercise between India and:
n4615455f47a.x: Khanjar is an India–Kyrgyzstan Special Forces exercise; its 13th edition was held at Missamari, Assam.

nfad2c8dfe51.s: India's nuclear doctrine, formulated in 2003, is based on:
o: First Use and credible minimum deterrence
No First Use and maximum deterrence
No First Use and credible minimum deterrence
nfad2c8dfe51.x: India's 2003 nuclear doctrine rests on No First Use and credible minimum deterrence.

nb1984c5f27b.s: The principal criticism of the GE F414 engine arrangement is that the ____ process remains with the United States.
nb1984c5f27b.x: The single-crystal blade process stays with the US, limiting technology transfer and keeping India dependent.

nda35b6e2b65.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Advanced Therapeutic Products (from July 2026)?
o: They were placed under the licensing of the Department of Biotechnology
They include gene therapies, cell/CAR-T products and xenografts
The change was made by amending the Drugs Rules, 1945
DBT handles genetic manipulation and biosafety
nda35b6e2b65.x: ATPs come under the Central Licence Approving Authority, not DBT; DBT only handles genetic manipulation and biosafety.

n578207ba50f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Gaganyaan mission?
o: It is designed to carry a crew of three
It is to fly to a 400 km orbit for three days
IADT-02 was done ahead of the uncrewed G1 flight
n578207ba50f.x: ESA, not NASA, will give ground-tracking support for Gaganyaan.

nc46784ed57f.s:
Assertion (A): LRLACM is a subsonic land-attack cruise missile developed by DRDO.
Reason (R): LRLACM has a range of more than 1,000 km.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nc46784ed57f.x: Both are true (it also uses the Manik engine and succeeds Nirbhay), but its range does not explain its being a subsonic land-attack cruise missile.

n6d92aaaa132.s: Which of the following pairs about the Indian Science Congress is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: 108th session theme – Science and Technology for Sustainable Development with Women Empowerment
Indian Science Congress Association – founded in 1947

n7d76095eda1.s: Which of the following pairs about the Himalayan Chandra Telescope is correctly matched?
n7d76095eda1.x: The 2-m telescope at Hanle, Ladakh (dedicated Aug 2001) is named after S. Chandrasekhar and run remotely from Hosakote by IIA.

n165e04b1058.s: Which of the following pairs of biotechnology regulatory function and body is correctly matched?
n165e04b1058.x: DBT oversees genetic manipulation and biosafety, while CDSCO grants clinical-trial and marketing approval.

neb6a3c80a9c.s: NISAR, described as a $1.5-billion Earth-observation satellite, was launched in July 2025 from:
neb6a3c80a9c.x: NISAR was launched from Sriharikota in July 2025; the Japanese H3 rocket is linked to Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX. (Sequence not buildable: one dated fact.)

n57f9454e1eb.s: The IndiaAI Mission (March 2024) under MeitY has an outlay of about:
n57f9454e1eb.x: The IndiaAI Mission has an outlay of about ₹10,372 crore and provides for more than 38,000 GPUs.

n37e8d74d551.s: The Sangam Digital Twin initiative is an initiative of:
n37e8d74d551.x: Sangam Digital Twin belongs to the Department of Telecommunications, not MeitY.

n4e0f74e4d1d.s: How many genomes does DBT's GenomeIndia project cover?
n4e0f74e4d1d.x: GenomeIndia covers 10,000 genomes from 83 population groups and plans to grow to 1 lakh genomes.

nbc2f9e8cc17.s: Chandrayaan-5 / LUPEX, the ISRO–JAXA lunar south-pole mission, is to be launched on:
nbc2f9e8cc17.x: LUPEX is to fly on Japan's H3 rocket (around 2028), not India's LVM3.

n58d85c6fffd.s: Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) is a single-dose vaccine against:
n58d85c6fffd.x: Ervebo is a single-dose Ebola vaccine, though it is not licensed for the Bundibugyo virus behind the 2026 outbreak.

ncb5fa648bf9.x: Agni-4 is a nuclear-capable MRBM with a range of about 4,000 km, not an ICBM.

n7b7784e04d8.s: The SHAKTI processor was developed by:
n7b7784e04d8.x: SHAKTI is from IIT Madras; VEGA is C-DAC's RISC-V processor series.

n65f626c39c6.x: DRDO was formed in 1958; its motto is 'Balasya Mulam Vigyanam'.

n79266de2fcd.s: Semicon 2.0 / ISM 2.0 offers capital-expenditure support of up to ____ for CMOS fabs.
n79266de2fcd.x: ISM 2.0 offers up to 40% capex support for CMOS fabs; the first commercial fab is targeted by 2028.

nd7066b82109.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the State Energy Efficiency Index?
o: The 2024 index was prepared by BEE with AEEE
Andhra Pradesh's score rose from 83.25 to 87.25
nd7066b82109.x: Andhra Pradesh, not Karnataka, topped the 2024 index; Karnataka led the 2023 index.

nf318f3d4a94.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about UNFCCC COP30?
o: It was held at Belem, the first COP in the Amazon
It operationalised the Loss and Damage Fund
It set a roadmap to US$1.3 trillion a year in climate finance by 2035
nf318f3d4a94.x: The Loss and Damage Fund was operationalised at COP28 in Dubai, not COP30.

n5f75480cbed.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh?
o: Guntur stood second in Swachh Vayu 2026
Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam is its largest tiger reserve
n5f75480cbed.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked second, not first, under MISHTI.

n645e3c5c3d5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Climate Change Performance Index 2026?
o: The top three positions were left vacant
India improved its position by 13 places
n645e3c5c3d5.x: India declined by 13 places, to 23rd, because of slow coal phase-down.

nf33bdd25ace.s:
Assertion (A): The Tropical Forest Forever Facility (TFFF) is Brazil's US$125 billion forest fund launched at COP30.
Reason (R): India is a full member of the TFFF.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf33bdd25ace.x: A is true. R is false: India joined the TFFF only as an observer.

n8622bdce320.s: Which of the following pairs about MISHTI is correctly matched?
n8622bdce320.x: MISHTI is a 2023 MoEFCC mangrove-restoration scheme in which AP ranked 2nd.

n4b39898dfd3.s: According to the World Air Quality Report 2025, which was the most polluted city?
n4b39898dfd3.x: Loni in Uttar Pradesh was the most polluted city, India stood sixth and New Delhi was the most polluted capital. (Sequence not buildable: no dates.)

n0a30dca4f13.s:
Assertion (A): Guntur jointly secured second position in the 3–10 lakh population category of Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026.
Reason (R): Lucknow topped its category in Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0a30dca4f13.x: Both are true, but Lucknow's result does not explain Guntur's ranking.

n32470cec065.s: Which of the following pairs about India in the Global Hunger Index is correctly matched?
n32470cec065.x: India was 102nd of 123 in GHI 2025 (score 25.8, 'serious'); 2024 was 105th of 127 (27.3) and 111th of 125 was 2023.

n0cd7c2f5699.s: Which States topped the SDG India Index 2023-24 with a score of 79?
n0cd7c2f5699.x: Kerala and Uttarakhand topped the NITI Aayog's 4th edition (July 2024) with 79.

n6e222c926ff.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Sangeet Natak Akademi?
o: It was set up in 1952 under the Ministry of Culture
Its Fellowships and Awards are conferred by the President
The Akademi Ratna carries ₹1 lakh and the Akademi Puraskar ₹3 lakh
It can have at most 40 living Fellows
n6e222c926ff.x: The amounts are reversed: the Ratna (Fellowship) carries ₹3 lakh and the Puraskar ₹1 lakh.

nfdf8a3ca9bc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: The National Awards for e-Governance recognise ICT-based service delivery
The National Energy Conservation Award is given by BEE
The National Energy Conservation Award is based on the SEEI
The National Awards for e-Governance are given by MeitY
nfdf8a3ca9bc.x: The National Awards for e-Governance are given by DARPG, not MeitY.

n368812c10a9.s:
Assertion (A): Vijay Amritraj received the Padma Bhushan 2026 in the field of sports.
Reason (R): Shibu Soren received the Padma Bhushan 2026 posthumously for public affairs.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n368812c10a9.x: Both are true, but Shibu Soren's award has nothing to do with Vijay Amritraj's.

na6a2ac2e8fc.s:
Assertion (A): The 60th Jnanpith Award to R. Vairamuthu was conferred posthumously.
Reason (R): R. Vairamuthu was the first Jnanpith recipient honoured mainly for poetry.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
na6a2ac2e8fc.x: A is false: the award was not posthumous. R is true: Vairamuthu, the third Tamil winner, was the first honoured mainly for poetry.

n62d7b47b818.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Nobel Prizes, 2025 is correctly matched?
n62d7b47b818.x: Kitagawa, Robson and Yaghi won Chemistry for MOFs; Medicine was for regulatory T-cells and Physics for macroscopic quantum tunnelling.

n737ceeac6ee.s: Which of the following pairs about the National Sports Awards is correctly matched?
o: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna – ₹25 lakh
n737ceeac6ee.x: The Khel Ratna (from 1991-92) carries ₹25 lakh; the Arjuna Award carries ₹15 lakh and Arjuna (Lifetime) dates from 2024.

n3b6f19033a1.s:
Arrange the following Nobel laureates in chronological order of their prize:
1. Jon Fosse (Literature)
2. Har Gobind Khorana (Medicine)
3. V. Ramakrishnan (Chemistry)
n3b6f19033a1.x: Khorana (1968) came first, then V. Ramakrishnan (2009, ribosome structure) and Jon Fosse (2023).

nb3201c02099.s: The Pulitzer Prizes are administered by:
nb3201c02099.x: The Pulitzers are administered by Columbia University; the Rockefeller Brothers Fund set up the Ramon Magsaysay Award.

n1b5f730692a.s: Which case held that Padma awards are not 'titles' prohibited by Article 18?
n1b5f730692a.x: The Balaji Raghavan case (1996) held Padma awards are not titles under Article 18, though they cannot be used as prefixes or suffixes.

n6441b501260.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed 2026 World Chess Championship match?
o: D. Gukesh is to defend the title against Javokhir Sindarov
The match is scheduled to be held in Geneva
Javokhir Sindarov is the defending champion
n6441b501260.x: D. Gukesh is the champion defending the title; Sindarov is the challenger.

nd27b72e3520.s: The first World Yogasana Championship, in which India topped the medal table, was held at:
nd27b72e3520.x: The first World Yogasana Championship was held at Ahmedabad. (NOT not buildable: only two facts.)

nc3d2c8acdfa.s:
Assertion (A): Veer Bhadu became India's first medallist in mixed martial arts at the 3rd Asian Youth Games 2025.
Reason (R): Veer Bhadu won a bronze medal in mixed martial arts at the 3rd Asian Youth Games 2025.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nc3d2c8acdfa.x: Both are true, and his bronze medal is what made him India's first MMA medallist at the Games.

nc93d5504701.s:
Assertion (A): The theme of World Soil Day 2025 was 'Healthy Soils for Healthy Cities'.
Reason (R): World Soil Day is observed on 5 December.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nc93d5504701.x: Both are true, but the date of observance does not explain the choice of theme.

n75a266ad4fd.s: 'Neither Roses Nor Thorns', recalling the ADM Jabalpur dissent, was written by:
n75a266ad4fd.x: 'Neither Roses Nor Thorns' is by Justice H.R. Khanna, recalling his ADM Jabalpur dissent.

nd3e0a75e347.s: 2026 was designated the International Year of the:
nd3e0a75e347.x: 2026 is the International Year of the Woman Farmer; 2025 was the year of Cooperatives and of Glaciers' Preservation.

n50e8385860e.s: The first Jnanpith Award (1965) was given to:
n50e8385860e.x: The first Jnanpith (1965) went to G. Sankara Kurup; the 60th (2025) went to R. Vairamuthu.

o: Shared between the author and the translator
Shared between the author and the publisher
ndbb4ec07752.x: The International Booker, for fiction translated into English, splits £50,000 between author and translator.

n2ac4d87d665.s: Good Governance Day (25 December) was declared and first observed in:
n2ac4d87d665.x: Good Governance Day, marking Vajpayee's birth anniversary, was first observed in 2014; 2015 is when Constitution Day began.

nbdf63304c58.s: 'Na Jeevitha Prasthanam' is the autobiography of:
nbdf63304c58.x: It is the autobiography of Nadendla Bhaskara Rao, CM of Andhra Pradesh for 31 days in 1984.

n85988d82d83.s: 'Gurajada Annarasha', Bobbili Sridhar's study of Gurajada Apparao's writing style, was released at:
n85988d82d83.x: The book, published by Sikkolu Book Trust, was released at Vizianagaram in August 2026, not by the Vice-President in New Delhi.

nf24886c6aa5.s: National Consumer Day is observed on:
nf24886c6aa5.x: National Consumer Day (24 December) is linked to the Consumer Protection Act, 1986.

n36828ed05f4.s: National Girl Child Day is observed on:
n36828ed05f4.x: National Girl Child Day is on 24 January, between National Youth Day (12 Jan) and National Voters' Day (25 Jan).

nc91db8c2b03.s: Which of the following pairs relating to persons who died in 2025–2026 is NOT correctly matched?
o: Khaleda Zia – Bangladesh's first woman Prime Minister
nc91db8c2b03.x: T.K. Oommen was a sociologist (Padma Bhushan 2008); 'journalist and author' describes Mark Tully.

na3ca6775f85.s: Which of the following pairs about the first women on the Lord's honours board (July 2026 Test) is correctly matched?
na3ca6775f85.x: Yastika Bhatia scored 113 and Kranti Gaud took a five-wicket haul to become the first women on the Lord's honours board.

n33285b943bc.s: The Chief Justice of India's temporary place on the CEC selection panel arose from which case (March 2023)?
n33285b943bc.x: The CJI's inclusion came from the Anoop Baranwal decision of March 2023, which the Supreme Court called temporary in May 2026.
